AUTHOR: M. Liu; B. Qin; H. Tang; S. Su
TITLE: FD-Net: A Model Based on Deep Learning for Deep-Sea Fish Detection
VENUE: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
SPECIES: 8 OzFish species tags plus a generic Fish class (species not listed)
DATA: OzFish public BRUV dataset (2,004 images, 43,572 labelled fish), relabelled to 9 classes
R_EV: Sec. IV.C: 'compares the performance evaluation metrics of YOLOv5, YOLOv6, YOLOv7 and FD-Net on the OzFish test set'
E_EV: Table I: only 'mAP(%) Precision(%) Recall(%) F1(%)' reported
ARCH: FD-Net (YOLO-style single-stage with MRCP, DmPooling, DACM)
NOTE: Paper calls OzFish 'deep-sea'; OzFish is BRUV imagery (ENV not stated in paper, left NR). Split: 'divides the OzFish dataset into training and validation sets in an 8:2 ratio' with no unit or randomisation stated, yet results reported on 'OzFish test set' - inconsistent; D1=NR per rule (could be read as image-level random). DSHR=공개 because data is the public OzFish dataset, not author-released.
